lines.text: You eat rice every day. But what happens to it inside your body? Let's follow it through Raju.
lines.tts: You eat rice every day. But what happens to it, inside your body? Let's follow it... through Raju.

lines.text: Inside, rice breaks down into sugar, called glucose. It soaks into his blood and travels everywhere.
lines.tts: Inside, rice breaks down into sugar, called glucose. It soaks into his blood, and travels everywhere.

lines.text: Glucose is fuel. But it can't walk into his cells on its own. It needs a key.
lines.tts: Glucose is fuel. But it can't walk into his cells on its own. It needs... a key.

lines.text: Stop one: the pancreas. It makes that key. It's called insulin.
lines.tts: Stop one: the pancreas. It makes that key. It's called insulin.

lines.text: Insulin unlocks the cells, sugar goes in, and Raju gets energy. That's how it's supposed to work.
lines.tts: Insulin unlocks the cells, sugar goes in, and Raju gets energy. That's how it's supposed to work.

lines.text: But years of extra rice, sweets, belly fat and sitting all day... the locks start getting rusty.
lines.tts: But years of extra rice, sweets, belly fat, and sitting all day... the locks start getting rusty.

lines.text: The pancreas panics and makes more and more insulin. Until one day, it's tired.
lines.tts: The pancreas panics, and makes more and more insulin. Until one day... it's tired.

lines.text: Now sugar stays stuck in the blood. That's type 2 diabetes.
lines.tts: Now sugar stays stuck in the blood. That's type two diabetes.

lines.text: And sugar in the blood is like sand in a pipe. Stop two: the eyes. Tiny vessels get damaged, and his vision blurs.
lines.tts: And sugar in the blood is like sand in a pipe. Stop two: the eyes. Tiny vessels get damaged, and his vision blurs.

lines.text: Stop three: the kidneys. Their filters wear out. And in his feet, nerves go numb, so a small cut can turn into a big wound.
lines.tts: Stop three: the kidneys. Their filters wear out. And in his feet, nerves go numb, so a small cut can turn into a big wound.

lines.text: It also raises his risk of heart attack and stroke. And early on? Often no symptoms at all.
lines.tts: It also raises his risk of heart attack, and stroke. And early on? Often... no symptoms at all.

lines.text: Watch for these: always thirsty, peeing often, tired, blurry vision, wounds that won't heal. Fasting sugar under 100 is normal. 126 or more means diabetes.
lines.tts: Watch for these: always thirsty, peeing often, tired, blurry vision, wounds that won't heal. Fasting sugar under one hundred is normal. One twenty-six or more, means diabetes.

lines.text: Raju takes charge: less rice, more vegetables and dal, a walk after every meal, and tablets as his doctor says. A few months later, his sugar is back in control.
lines.tts: Raju takes charge: less rice, more vegetables and dal, a walk after every meal, and tablets as his doctor says. A few months later, his sugar is back in control.

lines.text: Over a hundred million Indians have diabetes. Don't wait for symptoms. Above thirty-five, or diabetes in your family? Get your sugar checked. A simple test can save your eyes, your kidneys, your life.
